name: loom-changes
description: loom's Changes piece: what's waiting to go up across the forges a household's projects live on, read-only, with the owner's Yes for the merges a rule says to ask about

scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s test -p 'test_*.py' && sh test/smoke.sh

loom.name: changes
loom.label: Changes
loom.description: What's waiting to go up: every open change in your projects' repos, by project, read-only, with Yes, merge it where a rule asks you.

settings.name: CHANGES_IDENTITIES
settings.label: Who reads which owner
settings.hint: JSON, like {"github:acme": "octocat"}: the forge login whose stored credential reads that owner's repos

settings.name: CHANGES_OWNER_LOGINS
settings.label: Your own forge logins
settings.hint: JSON, like ["octocat"]: your own changes read as yours

settings.name: CHANGES_PROJECTS
settings.label: How to list projects
settings.hint: a command that prints project cards as JSON

settings.name: CHANGES_TASKS
settings.label: How to read tasks
settings.hint: the tasks piece's command; its export is read for citations

settings.name: CHANGES_GH
settings.label: The gh command
settings.hint: a path to the GitHub CLI, if gh on PATH isn't the plain one
